title: Raporty klimatyczne dla Polski (Climate reports for Poland)
organization: Institute of Meteorology and Water Management – National Research Institute (IMGW-PIB)
temporal_coverage: National observations for 2025 compared with the 1991–2020 normal.
methodology: Official IMGW-PIB report-entry summary reports national station-network measurements for 2025 against the 1991–2020 normal.
limitations: The linked report PDF was inaccessible; only the publisher summary was read, so no regional breakdown or detailed methods are claimed.

title: Zmiana klimatu w Polsce. Fakty, liczby, skutki
organization: Ministry of Climate and Environment of Poland
temporal_coverage: Temperature trend since 1951; March 2026 conditions; water-availability and European drought statistics reported for recent years including 2025.
methodology: Ministry explainer synthesizes climate statistics and consequences, citing IMGW, IOŚ-PIB and Copernicus.
limitations: The page does not reproduce measurement uncertainty, full methods or regional disaggregation for every statistic.

title: Susza w Wielkopolsce. Partnerstwo regionalne
organization: Ministry of Climate and Environment of Poland
temporal_coverage: Regional water-balance trends described since the beginning of the 21st century; partnership letter signed 2 April 2026; projects reported as in implementation.
methodology: Ministry page summarizes regional drought assessment, partnership and projects.
limitations: No underlying hydrological data or project evaluation is presented.

title: Urban Overheating & Adaptation Measures: An Analysis at EU, National, and Local Level
temporal_coverage: Polish city adaptation-project implementation and reported measures mainly cover 2001–2019; report published in 2024.
methodology: World Bank review includes national policies and Polish city adaptation cases.
limitations: Not an impact evaluation; underlying municipal plans were not inspected.

title: Prime Minister: We will spare no expense rebuilding flooded areas
organization: Chancellery of the Prime Minister of Poland
geographic_coverage: flood-affected settlements under a state of natural disaster
temporal_coverage: Preliminary flood-impact and evacuation figures presented at a government briefing on 21 September 2024.
methodology: Chancellery statement summarizes preliminary reports supplied by regional governors at the 21 September 2024 crisis meeting.
limitations: Figures were provisional; standing water prevented complete inspection, and the statement gives no final loss assessment.

title: Wsparcie samorządów w działaniach na rzecz adaptacji do zmiany klimatu
organization: Ministry of Climate and Environment of Poland
temporal_coverage: Eastern Poland municipal support project under the 2021–2027 EU programme; city adaptation plans due by 2 January 2028.
methodology: Ministry page outlines the Eastern Poland adaptation project.
limitations: No independent project evaluation is provided.
